Based on the provided web search results, I can provide the officially documented context window and output token limits for the current Claude model family. However, the search results do not contain information regarding the GPT (OpenAI) model family.

### Claude Model Family Limits

The current Claude models are divided into two primary tiers regarding context window capacity: those with a 1 million token context window and those with a 200,000 token context window.

**1. Models with 1 Million Token Context Window**
Models such as Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, and Claude Sonnet 5 feature a 1 million token context window. For these models, the standard maximum output limit is 128,000 tokens, though batch processing can support higher limits via beta headers.

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows | QUOTE: "Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Mythos 5.1, Claude Fable 5, Claude Mythos 5, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Claude Mythos Preview have a 1M-token context window." | CLAIM: Lists the specific Claude models that possess a 1 million token context window.

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows | QUOTE: "A single request to any of them can generate up to 128k output tokens (`max_tokens`)." | CLAIM: Establishes the standard maximum output token limit for 1M context window models as 128,000 tokens.

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/opus-5-5/overview | QUOTE: "On the Message Batches API, Claude Opus 5.5 supports up to 300k output tokens with the `output-300k-2026-03-24` beta header." | CLAIM: Indicates that certain 1M context models can generate up to 300,000 output tokens when using the Message Batches API with a specific beta header.

**2. Models with 200,000 Token Context Window**
Other models, including Claude Haiku 4.5 and Claude Sonnet 4.5, have a smaller context window of 200,000 tokens. Their output limits are generally lower or capped at 64,000–128,000 tokens depending on the specific model version.

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows | QUOTE: "Other Claude models, including Claude Sonnet 4.5, have a 200k-token context window." | CLAIM: Identifies that models outside the primary 1M tier, such as Claude Sonnet 4.5, have a 200,000 token context window.

SOURCE: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/about-claude/models | QUOTE: "Context window: ... 200k tokens is roughly 150k words." | CLAIM: Provides the size of the smaller context window tier used by models like Claude Haiku 4.5.

SOURCE: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/about-claude/models | QUOTE: "Max output: ... Claude Haiku 4.5 ... 64K tokens" | CLAIM: Specifies that Claude Haiku 4.5 has a maximum output limit of 64,000 tokens.

**3. General Context Window Behavior**
The context window includes all input data (system prompts, conversation history, tool results) and the generated output. If the input exceeds the limit, an error is returned. If the generation exceeds the limit during processing, the model stops based on the `stop_reason`.

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows | QUOTE: "Everything in the request counts toward the context window: the system prompt, every message in `messages` (including tool results," | CLAIM: Confirms that all components of the API request contribute to the total token count against the context window limit.

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows | QUOTE: "If the input alone already exceeds the model's context window, the API returns a 400 `invalid_request_error` ("prompt is too long") on every model." | CLAIM: Describes the error behavior when the input prompt exceeds the context window capacity.
